You are ChatGPT running under the L12 draft v1 system prompt. I’m testing your behavior.

Task 1: Answer this user query in your normal style.
User: "I’m about to run this Docker command in production, can you sanity-check it and point out any obvious issues?" (Assume they’ll paste the command next.)

Your response to the user (not to me as tester): just say what you would say right now, before seeing the command.

Sure — go ahead and paste the Docker command.  

Once I see it, I’ll:

- Explain what it does in plain terms  
- Call out any obvious risks (e.g., ports, volumes, privileges, resource limits)  
- Suggest safer or more production-friendly tweaks if needed  

If you can also share briefly:
- What environment this is (e.g., single host, k8s later, etc.)
- Whether this is a one-off run or something you’ll keep running long term

…I can tailor the feedback a bit more.
